children: Morrow Bank AB (publ) will publish its interim report for Q3 2026 on Thursday, 12 November 2026 at 7:00 a.m. CET. The quarterly report and presentation material will be made available online at

In conjunction with this, analysts, investors and media are invited to a webcast on the same day at 10:00 a.m. CET, where CEO Øyvind Oanes and CFO Eirik Holtedahl will present and comment on the report.
To participate via the webcast, please click on the link below:
The presentation will be given in English and viewers are invited to ask questions in the live chat.

Morrow Bank is a Nordic consumer finance bank offering digital and flexible financing solutions to creditworthy individuals in Norway, Sweden and Finland. The bank offers consumer loans, credit cards and high-yield deposit accounts, supported by a modern and scalable banking platform.
